bant.notes: Budget line exists for VMware renewal; CIO owns the decision; renewal date is the forcing event.

meddpicc.notes: Pain is quantified (renewal quote in hand). Infrastructure manager is an active champion. Nutanix has presented once; no formal RFP yet.

business.outcomes: Exit the VMware renewal cycle before December, cut virtualization run cost, and create a path to containerize the in-house MES and logistics apps without buying a second platform.
business.constraints: Change freeze mid-November to mid-January (production peak). Capex approval board meets quarterly, next sitting mid-September.
business.budget_range: Directional 1.2M USD over 3 years for platform and migration
business.decision_timeline: Decision by end of September 2026, PO before the November freeze
business.success_criteria: Renewal avoided, 90% of VMs migrated within 6 months, MES pilot containerized within 12 months

stakeholders.name: Farah Malik
stakeholders.notes: Economic buyer. Cares about renewal cost and risk of a rushed migration.

stakeholders.name: Adeel Khan
stakeholders.notes: Runs the VMware estate. Burned by the uplift quote. Wants a platform his team can grow into.

stakeholders.name: Sana Riaz
stakeholders.notes: Interested in the MES modernization angle, worried about migration disrupting the app teams.

stakeholders.name: Imran Bukhari
stakeholders.notes: Will challenge every TCO number. Wants the status quo cost modeled honestly, including the do-nothing risk.

estate.storage_platform: vSAN (all-flash) plus one legacy FC SAN for the ERP cluster

workloads.name: ERP (Oracle EBS)
workloads.notes: Stays as VMs. Oracle licensing sensitivity, keep on dedicated hosts.

workloads.name: MES (in-house Java)
workloads.notes: Primary containerization candidate, dev team already using Docker locally.

workloads.name: Logistics & WMS
workloads.notes: Vendor roadmap includes a container distribution in 2027.

workloads.name: Dev/test
workloads.notes: First migration wave candidate, low blast radius.

technical.pain_points: VMware renewal quote up 65% under the new subscription model. vSphere 7 estate needs a major upgrade either way (ESXi 7 past end of general support since October 2025). Team of 5 admins stretched. App teams complain provisioning takes two weeks.

growth.notes: Organic growth plus a second packaging line coming online in 2027.

vmware.pain: Quoted VCF subscription at 1.18M USD for 3 years, 65% above prior ELA. Only need vSphere+vSAN, forced to buy the full VCF bundle. Account team unresponsive since Broadcom transition.

assumptions.text: Renewal quote of 1,180,000 USD is for a 3-year VCF subscription covering the full 48-socket estate
assumptions.source: Adeel Khan, quote email shared in workshop

assumptions.text: Powered-on VM count (385) used for sizing; powered-off VMs assumed archivable
